params.text:
According to the population pyramid of Japan in 2026 shown in the English Wikipedia article 'Demographics of Japan', **females aged 75-79 represent 3.9% of the total population**.

This is clearly visible in the population pyramid image (File: Japan population pyramid 2026.png), where the red bar for the 75-79 age group on the female (right) side is labeled **3.9%**.
